columns: What it would take away, as measured on build 8
rows: Handle a slider's change event without an edit of the program, as cut A did for its input events, or do the edit's work after the paint.
Statics and syntax (32 ms) and the whole slide's view (91 ms), all before the paint at 176 ms (build 8).

done (b37d2e6df1, build 12): when the compiled run has answered, the page draws first and makes the edit after the paint. A step shows in 19 to 24 ms (the first of four, 124). The edit itself is still made, after the paint (^ticket(721)).
Draw only the livelits a drag changes: make the editors' and projectors' views incremental.
Most of the page's view: 10.1 ms of a 17.1 ms median frame of a drag (build 8); and the whole views after each worker message.

first part done (d9d63c13af, build 12): each editor's decorations and probes' views reused across a drag's frames, the view 6.1 ms a frame (8.2 to 10.1 on builds 8 to 11). Then the outline out of the view (bfbd88a1ae, 8bf44f23cf; build 13), built on its own after the paint: the whole views after each worker message 45 to 63 ms (88 to 130 on build 12), a drag's view 4.9 ms a frame. Left: the projector layer, and those whole views.
Compile the program once, not again after a step that changed only a livelit's model: keep the compiled program, and give it the new models.
126 to 141 ms of the page's thread after each step (build 8).

done (7f5add1519, 3e51af567f; builds 9 and 10): kept at every step on the Witch, 5 of 5; 29 to 51 ms of comparing after the paint in place of 126 to 141 ms of compiling. Next: a cheaper comparison, since 22 to 39 ms of it copies the program.
Leave the worker out when the compiled run has answered: keep the run's answers when the worker catches up, and hold the worker's request until the steps stop.
The page drawing every livelit again from the worker's answer, to the same picture; the worker's run for each step of a quick series.

partly done (7f5add1519, build 9): the answers are kept each time the worker catches up (10 on the Witch) and its request is held 400 ms. But each of the worker's two messages still costs the page a calculate and a whole view, 95 to 143 ms a view (45 to 63 since build 13 took the outline out), now drawing every livelit from the kept answers. What is left is step 1's.
Send values as data where they cross: the worker's answer and its probe samples without ids, holes or closures.
The answer is 0.59 MB, encoded in 67 to 99 ms in the worker and decoded in 18 to 56 ms in the page (builds 9 and 10); the Witch's picture is 3 times smaller as data (^report(47)).

first slice tried, and off (1524e96da3, build 11; off since 22cd278106): the values that went as data came back the same, but only 5 a message passed the strict check, and rebuilding the samples lost Marshal's sharing, so the answer grew to 0.89 MB. Now a survey counts why values are not data; next, make data where samples are made (^ticket(718)).
